Neutral drawings show conditions; new constructions appear in the corresponding steps.
Alternative cases have distinguishable geometry and readable labels at320/1280.

pageContext.finalRecapture: 64 of64 final-bundle PNGs are byte-identical to the already manually reviewed prior capture; all hashes compared, no visual inference from a merely similar screenshot.
pageContext.limitations: The full-page pass covers initial and fully expanded final states, not full-page screenshots of every intermediate view. Every model intermediate view is covered separately above.
